title: Open Interest
supported_mechanism_claims: Open interest measures outstanding futures contracts rather than volume traded.
Every matched futures contract has long and short counterparties; aggregate OI alone does not resolve directional inventory.
scope_note: General market terminology only; no BTC outcome evidence imported.

title: USD-M futures market data: mark/index price, funding and open interest
supported_mechanism_claims: Open-interest, mark/index and funding interfaces have distinct publication/update conventions and raw units.
Historical as-of feature construction must respect the observed receive time, not just an exchange-provided nominal timestamp.
scope_note: Source documents public endpoints; does not prove historical availability, full feed completeness, or predictive outcomes.

title: USD-M futures liquidation-order snapshot stream
supported_mechanism_claims: Documented force-order stream reports latest liquidation-order snapshot within 1000 ms per symbol.
Observed force orders must not be equated to a complete liquidation-event census or to identified account distress.
scope_note: Endpoint format and venue scope may change; verify historical collection semantics independently before D0 testing.
